# ModForge editor text: 中文（简体） (zh-Hans)
# 
# 
# Every word the editor shows is here, one text per line: key = text.
# A translation is a copy of this file with the text after each = in another
# language, named for that language: es.txt, pt-BR.txt, zh-Hans.txt...
# Language > New or update a translation, in the editor, writes one for you
# to start from.
# The texts under [In the game] are the ones the game shows players; the
# rest is the editor. One file does both: put it in the editor's languages
# folder, and in the game's BepInEx\plugins\SMSModForge\Languages folder.
# 
# Lines starting with # are notes, and [headings] only help you find your way.
# Neither changes anything.
# Keep {words in braces}, <tags> and [TOKENS:like this] exactly as they are:
# something fills them in or reads them.
# \n starts a new line. An underscore marks the letter Alt reaches a menu by.
# Nothing after the = shows the English. "" shows nothing, on purpose.
# A key ending in .one or .other is one form of a sentence with a number in it.
# A translation has the forms its own language uses; ModForge writes them out.

[This file]

# Tooltip on the 'Value' field of the SetVariable action
# en: New value. Strings round-trip as-is; use 'true' / 'false' for booleans, and numbers in invariant-culture form (e.g. '3.14'). '$varName' copies that variable's current value instead ('$$' escapes a literal dollar). Leave it blank to CLEAR the variable to an empty string — that's kept as a real value, not treated as an unfilled row.
action.setVariable.value.tip = 新值。字符串原样保存；布尔值用 'true' / 'false'，数字用固定区域性格式（例如 '3.14'）。'$varName' 则改为复制该变量的当前值（'$$' 表示一个真正的美元符号）。留空可把变量“清空”为空字符串——这会作为真正的值保存，而不是未填写的行。

# en: Numeric pack variable to add to (negative delta subtracts).

# Tooltip on the 'Focused' field of the CharacterFocus action
# en: When true, every actor's bust in the dialogue is bumped above the CG layer; when false, their resting sorting orders are restored. No per-actor target — it focuses the whole cast, and resets automatically when the dialogue ends.
action.setSpriteFocus.focused.tip = 为真时，对话中每位演员的立绘都会提到 CG 层之上；为假时恢复各自原本的绘制顺序。没有针对单个演员的目标——它作用于全体角色，并在对话结束时自动恢复。

action.setGameObjectActive.path.tip = 模组包的叠加层或立绘名称（可自动补全）、游戏的 GO 名称，或完整的层级路径（'5_Levels/14_Beach/Foreground/Thing'）。未激活的对象同样能找到，所以可以启用一开始就处于关闭状态的东西。

# Label beside a field of an action or condition
# en: Active
param.label.active = 激活

# Tooltip on the 'Active' field of the SetGameObjectActive action
# en: true to switch the target on, false to switch it off, or toggle to flip it to the opposite of whatever it currently is. Toggle reads the object's own state, so a parent being hidden around it does not count as off.
action.setGameObjectActive.active.tip = true 开启目标，false 关闭目标，toggle 则把当前状态反转。toggle 读取对象自身的状态，所以外层父对象被隐藏并不算作关闭。

# Tooltip on the 'Target' field of the GameObjectActive condition
# en: The object to test. Category decides how it resolves: a bust, an overlay inside a chosen level, a scene, or a raw GameObject name or hierarchy path. condition.gameObjectActive.target.tip = 要检查的对象。类别决定它如何被解析：立绘、所选关卡内的叠加层、场景，或直接的 GameObject 名称或层级路径。只要解析到的对象在层级中处于激活状态就成立；找不到的对象与关闭等同，所以“取反”意味着“关闭或不存在”，而不只是“关闭”。

# Tooltip on the 'Key' field of the InputKey condition

# Label beside a field of an action or condition

# Tooltip on the 'Chance' field of the Random condition
# en: DEPRECATED — re-rolls on EVERY evaluation. In a per-frame context (integration rule, dialogue start conditions, button visibility) that means ~60 rolls/second and the probability is meaningless. Switch to 'DailyChance' (once per day) or a LevelRandom variable + comparison.
condition.random.chance.tip = 已弃用——每次求值都会重新掷一次。在逐帧求值的场合（集成规则、对话开始条件、按钮可见性），这相当于每秒约 60 次，概率就失去意义了。请改用 'DailyChance'（每天一次）或 LevelRandom 变量 + 比较。

# Tooltip on the 'Chance' field of the DailyChance condition
# en: Probability of passing, as a whole percentage. 50 = passes on ~half of in-game days. Rolled once per in-game day: the result holds all day, survives save/reload, and changes at each day roll-over. Every DailyChance rolls independently — the console names each one after its dialogue/rule at the day change.
condition.dailyChance.chance.tip = 成立的概率，用整数百分比表示。50 = 大约一半的游戏日成立。每个游戏日掷一次：结果整天保持不变，存档/读档后仍然有效，并在每次日期切换时变化。每个 DailyChance 各自独立掷点；日期切换时，控制台会按各自的对话/规则名称逐一列出。

# Tooltip on the 'Stagger start' field of the Timer condition

# Tooltip on "Drift with the level"

gameObject.driftLevel.tip = 开启（默认）会沿用关卡自身的强度，这也是创建出来的对象一贯的行为。关闭后可以单独设定这个对象的景深。

# Tooltip on a text box
# en: Depth relative to the level's main sprite, which every vanilla level fixes at 0.75: lower sits further away and lags behind the room, higher sits nearer and overshoots. Vanilla objects use 0.1, 0.5, 0.75 and 1.5.
gameObject.depthRelativeLevelS.tip = 相对于关卡主精灵图的景深，每个原版关卡都固定为 0.75：更小则更远，落后于房间；更大则更近，会超出房间的移动幅度。原版对象使用 0.1、0.5、0.75 和 1.5。

# Tooltip on "Reversed"
# en: Drift WITH the cursor instead of against it.
gameObject.reversed.tip = 跟随光标漂移，而不是与之相反。

# Tooltip on "UI space"
# en: Only for an object under a Canvas — it switches the effect to canvas coordinates. A pack's own GameObjects are world sprites, so leave this off unless you're binding to a canvas object.
gameObject.uiSpace.tip = 仅用于 Canvas 下的对象——它会把效果换成画布坐标。模组包自己的 GameObject 是世界精灵图，所以除非你绑定的是画布对象，否则请保持关闭。

gameObject.optionalPackRelativeMask.tip = 可选的、相对于模组包的遮罩 PNG，绑定到 _MaskTex，用于带着色器遮罩的叠加层（比如一次客串出场）。

gameObject.addComponent.tip = 给这个 GameObject 附加一个通用工具组件（淡入、淡出、随机子对象、闪烁）。

# Tooltip on "+ Condition"

# Tooltip on "Switch back off when the conditions stop matching"

# Tooltip on the room a script of the game's sits in

# Tooltip on "_Spell-check node text"

A language Windows has no spelling dictionary for is not underlined at all; Windows' language settings can add one. Right-click a squiggle in the Text field for suggestions, to ignore it for this session, or to add the word to your Windows dictionary (the same list Edge and Office use). Turning this off also makes the node list lighter to scroll on very long dialogues. Your choice is remembered between sessions.
menu.spellCheckNodeText.tip = 用 Windows 自带的拼写检查器，按台词所用的语言（模组包自己的语言，或你正在编辑的语言）标出拼写错误——既在节点的“文本”字段里，也在节点列表中，这样浏览时就能看到错误。Windows 没有词典的语言完全不会被标出；可以在 Windows 的语言设置中添加词典。在“文本”字段的波浪线上点击右键可以查看建议、在本次会话中忽略它，或把这个词加入你的 Windows 词典（与 Edge 和 Office 使用的是同一个列表）。关闭它也会让很长的对话中的节点列表滚动起来更轻快。你的选择会在不同会话之间保留。

Everything in the dialogue, scene or rule you have up counts - the characters it names, its places, its variables, the folder it is in - and it follows your edits as you make them. Nothing is picked or hidden for you, and other dropdowns showing the same list keep their own order. Turn this off to have every list in its usual order.
menu.smartSuggestions.tip = 打开空的下拉框时，根据你正在编辑的内容判断可能性较大的选项会移到顶部，并标上星号：比如在一段任意处提到某个角色、发生在某个地点的对话里，“设为激活”动作会先列出这个角色在这个地点的场景。你打开的对话、场景或规则中的一切都算数——其中提到的角色、地点、变量、所在的文件夹——并且会随着你的编辑实时更新。不会替你选择或隐藏任何东西，显示同一列表的其他下拉框也保持各自的顺序。关闭此项，所有列表都按平常的顺序排列。

menu.versionPackAutomatically.tip = 每次保存都推进模组包的版本：模组包新增了内容就升次版本号，已有内容发生改动就升修订号。主版本号永远不会自动推进——那一位表示“这是模组包的新版本”，要由你来决定。关闭后，版本只有你亲手输入时才会改变。

# Text
# en: Everything this place builds under its level, as one hierarchy. A GameObject with a Sprite is a layered sprite object (backdrop, prop, animated layer); leave the Sprite blank for a pure container that just groups children. Every node takes utility components (fade, disappear, random child, blink), nested children, and NPC placements. The NPCs node is the level's own NPCs object — always present, and the home for the NPC hierarchy; its subtree composes local transforms down the chain, so moving a container moves everything under it. Target any node from dialogue by Name with SetGameObjectActive / FadeSprite / MoveGameObject / SpinGameObject. Lower sorting draws further back.
places.everythingPlaceBuildsUnder = 这个地点在它的关卡下构建的一切，作为一整个层级。带精灵图的 GameObject 就是分层的精灵对象（背景、道具、动画图层）；若只想要一个用来归拢子对象的纯容器，把精灵图留空即可。每个节点都能加工具组件（淡入、淡出、随机子对象、闪烁）、嵌套子对象和 NPC 摆放。NPCs 节点就是关卡自己的 NPC 对象——它始终存在，也是 NPC 层级的归属之处；它的子树会逐级叠加局部 transform，所以移动一个容器就会移动它下面的一切。在对话里可用 SetGameObjectActive / FadeSprite / MoveGameObject / SpinGameObject 按“名称”定位任意节点。排序值越小，画得越靠后。

places.runtimeName.tip = 条件/动作和导航目标引用这个地点时使用的名称（place:<name>）。在你没有自行设定之前，它会跟随显示名称自动填写；一旦你在这里输入，它就不再跟随，这样已经确立的地点就不会在已有引用之下被悄悄改名。

# Tooltip on a text box
# en: The name the pack itself uses — what the runtime calls this in its log, what validation messages name, and what another pack would reference it by. It is written for you from the display name, so there is nothing to fill in; it is shown because those three places quote it back at you. Select it to copy.
places.namePackItselfUses.tip = 模组包自己使用的名称——运行时日志里写的、验证消息里提到的，也是别的模组包引用它时用的。它会根据显示名称自动写好，所以这里没什么要填；之所以显示出来，是因为那三处都会把它原样引用给你看。选中即可复制。

# Tooltip on a text box
# en: The object the level is built as in game. This place's is named otherwise than its runtime name - from an older version, where the two were apart. Other mods may find the level by this name.
places.objectLevelBuiltGame.tip = 关卡在游戏中构建成的那个对象。这个地点的对象名称与它的运行时名称不同——它来自两者分开的旧版本。其他模组可能会用这个名称找到这个关卡。

places.useRuntimeName = 使用运行时名称

# Tooltip on that button
# en: Name the level's object by the runtime name, and keep it following the runtime name from now on, as new places do. Another mod that finds this level by its old name will not find it any more.
places.useRuntimeName.tip = 用运行时名称来命名关卡的对象，并从此跟随运行时名称变化，就像新地点一样。用旧名称寻找这个关卡的其他模组将再也找不到它。

# Tooltip on a text box

# Tooltip on a text box
# en: SpriteRenderer sorting order of the front sprite. −10 is the prototype's, and what all but four vanilla levels use. Lower it to park objects behind the level art. Written as baseSortingOrder.
places.spriterendererSortingOrderFront.tip = 前景精灵图 SpriteRenderer 的排序值。原型用的是 −10，除四个之外的所有原版关卡也都用它。调低它可以把对象放到关卡美术之后。写作 baseSortingOrder。

# Tooltip on a part of the window
# en: Optional, and bound as _MaskTex on the BACK sprite's material. Vanilla leaves that sprite on a plain material with nothing to displace it; setting a mask here gives it its own clone of the level's jiggle material, so water or foliage behind the room can move independently. Blank = vanilla behaviour. Written as secondaryMaskSprite.
places.optionalBoundMasktexBACK.tip = 可选，作为 _MaskTex 绑定到“后景”精灵图的材质上。原版让那张精灵图使用普通材质，没有任何东西让它形变；在这里设置遮罩，会给它一份关卡晃动材质的独立克隆，于是房间后面的水面或枝叶就能独立地动起来。留空 = 原版行为。写作 secondaryMaskSprite。

# Tooltip on "Edit…"
# en: Paint this mask over the back art.
places.editPlaceSecondaryMask.tip = 在后景美术上绘制这张遮罩。

# Tooltip on a part of the window
# en: Bound as _MaskTex on the FRONT sprite's material only. The back sprite and every GameObject in the place are unaffected. Loaded as linear data, not colour, because it carries amounts rather than pixels. Written as maskSprite.
places.boundMasktexFRONTSprite.tip = 仅作为 _MaskTex 绑定到“前景”精灵图的材质上。后景精灵图以及该地点中的所有 GameObject 都不受影响。它按线性数据而非颜色加载，因为它承载的是数值而不是像素。写作 maskSprite。

# Text
# en: Click a node to select it. + Sibling adds a line directly below it and + Child one inside it; both take only its speaker (actor, expression and outfit) - Duplicate (Ctrl+D) and copy and paste carry a whole node. Naming an actor who has spoken earlier in this conversation brings back the expression and outfit they last wore. Drag a node to move it (with its children): drop on the upper or lower edge of a row to place it before or after as a sibling, drop on the middle to make it a child, or drop below the list to make it a root. Ctrl+C / Ctrl+V copy a node and its children and paste them below the selection; Del removes the selected node. Nodes play top to bottom, exactly as listed.
dialogues.clickNodeSelectChild = 点击节点即可选中它。“+ 同级”在它正下方添加一句台词，“+ 子节点”在它里面添加一句；两者都只沿用它的说话者（演员、表情和服装）——要带走整个节点，用“复制”（Ctrl+D）或复制粘贴。指定一个在这段对话里已经说过话的演员，会恢复他上次的表情和服装。拖动节点可移动它（连同子节点）：放在某一行的上边缘或下边缘，就作为同级放在它前面或后面；放在中间，就成为它的子节点；放到列表下方，就成为根节点。Ctrl+C / Ctrl+V 可复制一个节点及其子节点，并粘贴到所选项下方；Del 移除选中的节点。节点自上而下播放，与列出的顺序完全一致。

# Tooltip on 'Sounds:'
# en: Every sound whose auto-trigger pattern is in this line, in the order they come. Each plays by itself; here you set how loud it is, when it starts, whether its words show and whether it waits for the typewriter. Every setting left as it is costs nothing in the pack.
cues.label.tip = 这句台词中出现了自动触发词的每个声音，按出现顺序排列。每个声音各自播放；你可以在这里设定它的响度、开始时间、是否显示它的文字，以及是否等待逐字显示。保持原样的设置在模组包里不占任何空间。

# Tooltip on a line's sound's volume
# en: How loud this sound plays in this line, against the volume the sound itself is set to on the SFX tab: 100 % is as set, more is louder. Leaves the size of the text alone.
cues.volume.tip = 这个声音在这句台词里播放的响度，以“音效”选项卡中为这个声音本身设定的音量为准：100 % 即按设定，更大则更响。不影响文字的字号。

cues.starts = 开始

# Tooltip on a line's sound's start
# en: When this sound starts, in seconds. The sentence beside it says from what: the first sound counts from when the line appears, each one after it from when the sound before it ends - so 0 is right after it, and below 0 plays over its end. A sound set to wait for the typewriter counts from when the typewriter reaches it.
cues.starts.tip = 这个声音开始的时间，以秒计。旁边的句子说明从什么时候算起：第一个声音从台词出现时算起，之后的每一个从前一个声音结束时算起——所以 0 是紧接其后，小于 0 则与它的结尾重叠。设为等待逐字显示的声音，从文字显示到它那里时算起。

# Tooltip on the box beside a line's sound's start slider
# en: The start in seconds; a minus sign makes it play over the end of the sound before it.
cues.delayBox.tip = 开始时间（秒）；加上负号会让它与前一个声音的结尾重叠播放。

# A line's first sound, starting later: {seconds} is a number

cues.startsAfterLine = 在台词出现后 {seconds} 秒开始。

# A line's later sound, starting right after the one before: {pattern} is that sound's words

# A line's later sound, starting a while after the one before ends

cues.startsBeforePreviousEnds = 在 {pattern} 结束前 {seconds} 秒开始，与它重叠播放。

# Tooltip on "Also leave on the Talk button (replayable)"
# en: Play on arrival like normal, AND stay on the vanilla Talk button so the player can hear it again — for as long as its start conditions still hold. Without this a dialogue interrupts once and is then gone until its conditions fail and pass again. Greyed out when 'Wait for Talk button' is on, which already leaves it there.
dialogues.alsoLeaveTalkButton.tip = 照常在进入时播放，同时还留在游戏的“交谈”按钮上，让玩家可以再听一次——只要它的开始条件仍然成立。没有这一项时，对话只会插入一次，之后就消失，直到它的条件先不成立、再重新成立。当“等待交谈按钮”打开时，这一项会变灰，因为那一项本来就把它留在那里了。

# Tooltip on "Wait for Talk button (no auto-play)"
# en: Don't start on arrival: the dialogue parks behind the vanilla Talk button, and the player starts it by clicking (with the normal cinematic fade). No jump-scare on level entry. Greyed out when the replay option above is on — that one plays on arrival, which is the opposite of waiting.
dialogues.waitTalkButtonNo.tip = 进入时不会开始：对话停在游戏的“交谈”按钮后面，由玩家点击来开始（带有正常的过场淡入淡出）。进关卡时不会被吓一跳。当上面的重播选项打开时，这一项会变灰——那一项是进入时就播放，与“等待”正好相反。

# Tooltip on "Queue behind active dialogue"
# en: If another dialogue is playing when this one's conditions pass, wait and start right after it ends. Unchecked (original behavior): it misses that window and only fires when its conditions trigger again while nothing is playing.
dialogues.queueBehindActiveDialogue.tip = 如果这段对话的条件成立时另有对话正在播放，就先等着，等它结束后立刻开始。不勾选（原本的行为）：它会错过那个时机，只有当它的条件在没有任何对话播放时再次成立才会触发。

# Tooltip on that tick
# en: The line reads exactly as written in every language. It is never offered for translating, and the game shows it as written whatever language the player picked. For a sound, a name on its own, or anything that must not change.
dialogues.textSameEverywhere.tip = 这一行在所有语言中都按原样显示。它不会被提供翻译，无论玩家选择哪种语言，游戏都按原样显示。适用于音效、单独的名字或任何不应改变的内容。

# Under a line's text: its words are never translated, only written in another alphabet's letters where a language has one
# en: Keep the words, change only the letters
dialogues.textLettersOnly = 保留词语，只换文字

# Tooltip on that tick
# en: For a made-up language, a spell or a chant: the words are never translated, so they cannot be turned into real words they happen to look like. In a language written in the same letters the line reads as written; in one with an alphabet of its own, like Russian or Japanese, each word is spelled out in its letters, so players can read it aloud.
dialogues.textLettersOnly.tip = 适用于虚构语言、咒语或吟唱：词语永远不会被翻译，因此不会被变成恰好相似的真实词语。在使用相同字母的语言中，这一行保持原样；在有自己文字的语言中（如俄语或日语），每个词都会用该语言的文字写出，方便玩家念出来。

# Tooltip on a part of the window
# en: The line itself. [PV:name] is replaced with a pack variable. {PC} is the player's name, and {M} {D} {B} are what this player calls their mother, father and brother — write those rather than the words, because players choose them. Markup is shown as the player will see it: the tags are set apart in their own colour and the words they wrap take their formatting. The game’s own tokens — {PC} and the rest — are marked the same way, in place, because a name goes there rather than those characters.
dialogues.nodeTextBox.tip = 台词本身。[PV:name] 会被替换成模组包变量。{PC} 是玩家的名字，{M} {D} {B} 则是这名玩家对母亲、父亲和兄弟的称呼——请写这些标记而不是具体的词，因为它们由玩家自己选择。标记会按玩家将看到的样子显示：标签以自己的颜色单独呈现，被包住的文字带上相应格式。游戏自己的标记——{PC} 等——也以同样方式就地标出，因为那里放的是一个名字，而不是这几个字符。

# Text
# en: Comma-separated list of text patterns. When any pattern appears in a dialogue node's text on node-start, the SFX fires automatically. If the effect has variants, one is picked at random each time — add them by putting files named <name>_1, <name>_2, … beside the base file (numbered without gaps). Convention: asterisk-bracketed lowercase tokens like *plap*, *smooch*. One SFX can carry multiple patterns — *yank*,*yeet* both fire the same clip just like the host mod does. Leave blank for an SFX that only plays via explicit PlaySFX actions.
sfx.commaSeparatedListText = 以逗号分隔的文本匹配词列表。节点开始时，只要对话节点的文本里出现其中任何一个词，这个音效就会自动播放。如果该效果有变体，每次都会随机挑一个——把名为 <name>_1、<name>_2… 的文件（编号连续、不跳号）放在基础文件旁边即可添加。惯例：用星号括起来的小写词，例如 *plap*、*smooch*。同一个音效可以带多个匹配词——*yank*,*yeet* 会触发同一段音频，与原版模组一致。若某个音效只应由明确的 PlaySFX 动作播放，请留空。

# Text
# en: Runs this whole rule once per value, so one rule can cover a set of subjects instead of copying it per subject. Values: a comma-separated list (A,B,C), or $variableName naming a List variable (or a String variable holding CSV) — so the set can change at runtime. Each value is substituted wherever {name} appears in any condition or action, including branches: e.g. Location_{char} as a variable name, or {char}/Slot as a GameObject path. It composes with the rest of the syntax — $Prefix_{char} dereferences the per-value variable. Every value gets its own edge state and its own Timer deadlines, so values behave exactly like the separate rules they replace (tick 'stagger' on a Timer to spread their first fire apart). Leave blank to run the rule once.
integration.runsWholeRuleOnce = 让整条规则对每个值各执行一次，这样一条规则就能覆盖一组对象，而不必为每个对象复制一份。值可以是：以逗号分隔的列表（A,B,C），也可以是 $变量名，指向一个列表变量（或存着 CSV 的字符串变量）——这样这组值可以在运行时改变。每个值都会替换掉任何条件或动作中出现的 {name}，包括分支里的：例如把 Location_{char} 用作变量名，或把 {char}/Slot 用作 GameObject 路径。它也能和其余语法组合——$Prefix_{char} 会解引用该值对应的变量。每个值都有自己的边沿状态和自己的计时器期限，所以这些值的行为与它们所替代的那些独立规则完全一样（在计时器上勾选“错开开始”即可把它们的首次触发岔开）。留空则整条规则只执行一次。

# Tooltip on "Share width"

# Tooltip on a dropdown
# en: Flexible fits as many across as the width allows; the other two fix the count.
ui.flexibleFitsManyAcross.tip = “弹性”会按宽度允许的数量横向排布；另外两种则固定数量。

# Tooltip on a tick box
# en: Nineteen things in rows of seven leave a last row of five, and it is normally packed against the start corner - so a grid that is even everywhere else ends lopsided. This centres that row, and only that row. Unity has no such setting, so the preview and the game both do it here.
ui.nineteenThingsRowsSeven.tip = 十九个东西按每行七个排，最后一行剩五个，通常会挤在起始的那一角——于是别处都很整齐的网格，结尾却歪了。这个选项会把那一行居中，而且只居中那一行。Unity 没有这样的设置，所以预览和游戏都在这里自己处理。

# Tooltip on a tick box
# en: With a set number of columns, the grid is only as wide as the columns its objects fill - two objects in a grid of eight columns make it two cells wide - so something sized to the grid, like a Content Size Fitter, grows and shrinks with what it holds. With a set number of rows, the same for its height. Unity's own grid is always as wide as all its columns. Only in the game: the preview draws the grid at its own size.
ui.fitToContent.tip = 列数固定时，网格只有被对象填满的那些列那么宽——八列的网格里有两个对象，就只有两格宽——所以像 Content Size Fitter 这样按网格定大小的东西会随内容伸缩。行数固定时，高度也一样。Unity 自带的网格总是所有列那么宽。只在游戏中生效：预览里网格按它自己的大小绘制。

# Tooltip on a text box
# en: Tint while the pointer is over this object, as #RRGGBB or #RRGGBBAA. Leave blank for no hover feedback. The game's own hover is per-button artwork rather than a rule, so there is nothing general to copy - this is the part a pack can state.
ui.tintWhilePointerOver.tip = 指针悬停在这个对象上时的着色，格式为 #RRGGBB 或 #RRGGBBAA。留空则没有悬停反馈。游戏自己的悬停效果是逐按钮的美术资源，而不是一条规则，所以没有通用做法可抄——这正是模组包可以自己声明的部分。

# Tooltip on a text box
# en: Its size while held down, as a fraction of its own - 0.95 shrinks it a little while the pointer is down and lets it back on release, everything on it too. Empty for none: then the game's own press plays as it is clicked, once let go. Set, it stands in for that press - useful when the click closes the screen before that press could be seen.
ui.pressScale.tip = 按住时的大小，按自身大小的比例填写——0.95 表示指针按下时稍微缩小，松开时恢复，上面的东西也一起。留空表示不做：这时会在点击（松开）时播放游戏自带的按下效果。填写后会代替那个按下效果——当点击会在按下效果显示前关闭界面时很有用。

# Tooltip on a dropdown
# en: What THIS object sounds like when clicked. Blank follows the screen, which is usually what you want - set this only where one button should differ. A sound named here plays even on a screen whose buttons are otherwise silent.
ui.whatObjectSoundsLike.tip = “这个”对象被点击时的声音。留空则跟随整个界面，通常这就是你想要的——只在某个按钮需要不同的时候才设置它。这里指定的声音，即使在按钮本来静音的界面上也会响。

# Tooltip on "+ Only if…"
# en: What has to be true for this click to do anything. Failing it runs none of the actions - the button still presses, it just does nothing.
ui.addClickCondition.tip = 这次点击要生效需要满足什么。不满足时一个动作都不会执行——按钮照样按下去，只是什么也不做。

# Tooltip on "+ Action"
# en: Run one of the pack's actions when this is clicked - the same actions dialogues and rules use.
ui.addAction.tip = 点击时执行模组包的某个动作——和对话、规则使用的是同一批动作。

# Tooltip on a dropdown
# en: A TextMeshPro font asset, not a font file. The same typeface appears more than once with different outlines and shadows, and they are not interchangeable.
ui.textmeshproFontAssetNot.tip = 一个 TextMeshPro 字体资源，而不是字体文件。同一种字型会以不同的描边和阴影出现多次，它们之间不能互换。

[Docs: What a mod pack is]

# Docs: a topic's title
# en: What a mod pack is
docs.modPack.title = 什么是模组包

# Docs: the line under the topic's title
# en: The whole idea, before any of the detail.
docs.modPack.summary = 在进入细节之前，先说整体思路。

# Docs: a point in the topic
# en: A pack is one folder. Everything you author ends up in a single file inside it called modpack.json, and the images and audio sit beside that file.
docs.modPack.packOneFolderEverything = 一个模组包就是一个文件夹。你创作的一切最终都会落到其中一个叫 modpack.json 的文件里，图片和音频则放在这个文件旁边。

# Docs: a point in the topic
# en: You never edit modpack.json by hand. The editor writes it, and its tabs are the things it can hold.
docs.modPack.neverEditModpackJson = 你永远不必手动编辑 modpack.json。它由编辑器写入，而编辑器的各个选项卡就是它能容纳的内容。

# Docs: a point in the topic
# en: Export turns the folder into one .smspack file. That is what you hand to players, and the only thing the game reads.
docs.modPack.exportTurnsFolderInto = 导出会把这个文件夹变成单个 .smspack 文件。那才是你交给玩家的东西，也是游戏唯一会读取的东西。

# Docs: a point in the topic
# en: The game does not know the editor exists. It reads your pack through the SMSModForge plugin, which is what actually builds your characters, rooms and conversations inside the running game.
docs.modPack.gameDoesNotKnow = 游戏并不知道编辑器的存在。它通过 SMSModForge 插件来读取你的模组包，而正是这个插件在运行中的游戏里真正构建出你的角色、房间和对话。

# Docs: a heading inside the topic
# en: Worth knowing
docs.modPack.heading.worthKnowing = 值得了解

# Docs: a point in the topic
# en: A pack adds to the game rather than replacing it. Your places sit alongside the game's own, and a vanilla extension adds to a room the game already has instead of swapping it out.
docs.modPack.packAddsGameRather = 模组包是在游戏之上做加法，而不是替换游戏。你的地点与游戏自有的地点并存，而原版扩展是在游戏已有的房间上添加内容，而不是把它换掉。

# Docs: a point in the topic
# en: Nothing you do in the editor touches your game installation until you export and copy the pack in yourself.
docs.modPack.nothingDoEditorTouches = 在你自己导出并把模组包复制过去之前，你在编辑器里做的任何事都不会碰你的游戏安装目录。

[Docs: The order to work in]

# Docs: a topic's title
# en: The order to work in
docs.orderWork.title = 制作顺序

# Docs: the line under the topic's title
# en: Which tabs depend on which, so you are not blocked halfway through.
docs.orderWork.summary = 哪些选项卡依赖哪些，免得你做到一半卡住。

# Docs: the bold label in front of the next text, usually a name on screen
# en: First
docs.orderWork.fileThenNewPack.term = 首先

# Docs: a point in the topic
# en: File then New pack, and Save straight away. Previews and file pickers resolve paths against the pack folder, so much of the editor stays empty until that folder exists on disk.
docs.orderWork.fileThenNewPack = 先“文件”再“新建模组包”，然后马上保存。预览和文件选择器都相对模组包文件夹来解析路径，所以在该文件夹落到磁盘上之前，编辑器的大部分内容都是空的。

docs.puttingValuesIntoText.boldItalicColouredText = 加粗、斜体和彩色文字。它们属于 TextMeshPro，也就是绘制气泡的那套系统；而 <size> 能生效这一点说明标记是被解析而不是被原样打印的。但游戏从未在自己的对话里用过这三个，所以这边没人亲眼见它们生效——在依赖它们之前，请先用一句台词试试。

Those are the forms the game's text engine reads; anything else leaves the words their ordinary colour. The Colour button picks one for you and writes six digits.
docs.puttingValuesIntoText.writtenRRGGBBRRGGBBAATransparency = 可写作 #RRGGBB、带透明度的 #RRGGBBAA、简写的 #RGB 和 #RGBA，或十个名称之一：red、lightblue、blue、grey、black、green、white、orange、purple、yellow。这些就是游戏文字引擎能读懂的写法；其他写法只会让文字保持原本的颜色。“颜色”按钮会替你挑一个，并写成六位数字。

# Docs: a point in the topic
# en: They do not run the game's logic. Conditions, variables and integration rules are not evaluated, so anything gated on state is drawn regardless.
docs.previews.theyDoNotRun = 它们不运行游戏的逻辑。条件、变量和集成规则都不会被求值，所以任何受状态控制的东西照样会被画出来。

# Docs: a point in the topic
# en: Previews resolve image paths against the pack folder, so they stay empty until the pack has been saved.
docs.previews.previewsResolveImagePaths = 预览是相对模组包文件夹来解析图片路径的，所以在模组包保存之前它们都是空的。

# Docs: a point in the topic
# en: Preview quality on the Options menu chooses how much of the game's look the previews draw, against processor load. The Quality buttons above each live preview are the same setting.
docs.previews.previewQualityOptionsMenu = 选项菜单中的预览质量用于选择预览绘制多少游戏画面效果，以换取处理器负载。每个实时预览上方的质量按钮是同一个设置。

# Docs: a point in the topic
# en: The place previews draw the game's look over the place, as the game does over every place: its bloom, its light streaks and its colour. Each has a tick box under the preview, and each is drawn only when its box is ticked and the preview quality draws it.
docs.previews.placesGameLook = 地点预览会像游戏对每个地点那样，在地点上绘制游戏画面效果：泛光、光条和色彩。每一项在预览下方都有一个复选框，只有勾选了它并且预览质量会绘制它时才会绘制。

# Docs: the bold label in front of the next text, usually a name on screen

# Docs: a point in the topic
# en: Choose how much of the game's look the previews draw, against processor load. Every quality draws as many frames as your display shows. Ultra is the game's own picture: the edge glow, bloom, light streaks and colour. High leaves out the light streaks, and on the processor works the edge glow out more quickly, without the bust's shadow in it; Medium leaves out the bloom too; Low the edge glow as well. With no backdrop the qualities save work too: Ultra draws a bust or an NPC as finely as the game does on a large screen, High with half the work, Medium a quarter, and Low one point for every four pixels.
docs.optionsMenu.tradePreviewSmoothnessAgainst = 选择预览绘制多少游戏画面效果，以换取处理器负载。每种质量绘制的帧数都与你的屏幕显示的一样多。极高就是游戏自己的画面：边缘光、泛光、光条和色彩。高去掉光条，并在处理器上更快地计算边缘光（不含半身像的阴影）；中再去掉泛光；低再去掉边缘光。没有背景时，各质量同样会减少工作量：极高把半身像或 NPC 画得和游戏在大屏幕上一样精细，高的工作量减半，中为四分之一，低则每四个像素画一个点。

# Docs: a point in the topic

The PC's room, the default, shows it as the game does there: the room behind, the light of its lamps, the glow its edges take from the room, and its breathing moving it over the room. The Beach, the Forest, the Villa and the Temple do the same in four more of the game's places, each with its own look. None shows the bust alone. The Backdrop buttons at the bottom of the Characters tab are the same setting, and the mask painter's preview follows it too.
docs.optionsMenu.previewBackdrop = 半身像预览把半身像画在什么上面。默认的主角的房间会按游戏在那里的样子显示：后面的房间、房间灯光、半身像边缘从房间获得的光，以及让它在房间上方移动的呼吸。海滩、森林、别墅和神殿在游戏的另外四个地点做同样的事，各有各的样子。无则只显示半身像。角色选项卡底部的背景按钮是同一个设置，遮罩绘制工具的预览也跟随它。

# Docs: a point in the topic

docs.optionsMenu.previewRenderer = 用什么来绘制实时预览。默认的自动会在编辑器启动时测试显卡和处理器的速度，并使用较快的那个。在显卡上，预览运行游戏自己的程序；第一次需要几秒钟来准备它们。

# Docs: a point in the topic

Exit stops the conversation and skips everything below. Jump resumes at whichever node carries the tag you name. Once that node and the lines under it are done, the game says again any line it is under, then that line's lines - so a jump that lands under the very line that jumps goes round for ever. A node at the top level carries on cleanly, and Validate warns about the others.
docs.dialogues.wherePlayGoesAfter = 这个节点之后播放去往哪里。继续是默认值，前往列表中的下一个节点，无论它是本节点的子节点还是更外层的内容。退出会停止对话并跳过下面的一切。跳转则在你指定的标签所在的节点继续。那个节点和它下面的台词结束后，游戏会把它上方的每句台词再说一遍，接着说那句台词下面的台词——所以落在发起跳转的那句台词下方的跳转会永远绕圈。最上层的节点会顺畅地继续，其他情况“验证”会给出警告。

# Docs: the bold label in front of the next text, usually a name on screen
# en: Changing a place
docs.quests.placesUnderStartedPut.term = 改动某一处

# Docs: a point in the topic
# en: On the places under Started by and Put back to not started by. Each of the game's conditions around the step is listed where it lives - a line on the way, the line itself, the place that plays the conversation, or the script. Take out removes one from the game (struck through, with Put back); a line's condition is taken out of your version of that conversation, a place's out of its script, and either way whatever else it guards happens without it too - the Dialogues tab shows the same change. Where the script sits is a row of its own and can be taken out as well. And only if (yours) adds conditions of your own. Once you change anything at a place, that place is yours: what is left - the game's conditions you kept, the room, and yours - is asked over and over, and the quest starts (or goes back to not started) the moment it all passes, whether or not the game's own conversation or script ever gets there. Take everything out and add a key press, and the key press starts it; take the room out too and it starts anywhere. A place you have not touched behaves as the game wrote it, and putting everything back gives it back to the game. A place also says which of the room's conversations the game tries first, which decides the conversation but not your rule, and the game's log says which one the room played. A changed place is marked with a dot, and its reset arrow puts it back the way the game has it. Places that complete, count or fail a task are shown, not changed.
docs.quests.placesUnderStartedPut = 位于「由以下位置开始」和「由以下位置退回未开始」之下的各处。游戏在该节点周围的每个条件都列在它所在的地方——沿途的某一行、这一行本身、播放该对话的位置，或者脚本。「移除」会把某个条件从游戏里拿掉（带删除线，旁边有「放回」）；某一行的条件会从你那份对话里拿掉，某个位置的条件会从它的脚本里拿掉，无论哪种，它守护的其他一切在没有这个条件时也照样发生——对话页签会显示同一处改动。脚本所在的位置单独占一行，同样可以移除。「并且仅当（你的）」则添加你自己的条件。只要你在某一处改动了任何东西，那一处就归你了：剩下的内容——你保留的游戏条件、房间，以及你自己的条件——会被反复询问，并在全部通过的那一刻开始任务（或把它退回「未开始」），无论游戏自己的对话或脚本是否走到过那里。把条件全部拿掉再加上一个按键，按键就能开始它；连房间也拿掉，它在哪里都能开始。你没有动过的位置仍然按游戏写的那样运作，把一切放回去就等于交还给游戏。每一处还会说明游戏会先尝试房间里的哪段对话，这决定的是对话而不是你的规则，游戏日志会说明房间最终播放了哪一段。改动过的位置会标上一个点，它的还原箭头会把它恢复成游戏原来的样子。完成、计数或判定步骤失败的位置只做展示，不可改动。

# Docs: a point in the topic
# en: Adding or taking out tasks can leave a save that is part-way through the quest unable to finish it, and so can removing your pack later. The editor says so in orange on any entry that does it. # Docs: the bold label in front of the next text, usually a name on screen
# en: Keyboard layouts
docs.conditions.gameReadsKeysPOSITION.term = 键盘布局

# Docs: a point in the topic
# en: The game reads keys by POSITION, not by the letter printed on the cap — the key called A is wherever A sits on a US keyboard, which is Q on AZERTY. The picker groups the letters, number row and punctuation separately for that reason; mouse buttons, arrows, modifiers, function keys and the numpad sit in the same place everywhere and are the safe choice for anything a player has to be able to press.
docs.conditions.gameReadsKeysPOSITION = 游戏按位置读取按键，而不是按键帽上印的字母——名为 A 的键就是美式键盘上 A 所在的那个位置，在 AZERTY 上那是 Q。选择器正因如此把字母、数字行和标点分开归组；鼠标按钮、方向键、修饰键、功能键和小键盘在各地都在同一个位置，是玩家必须按得到的操作的稳妥选择。

# Docs: a point in the topic
# en: Objects that start switched off are still found, so an action can turn on something that was never visible.

# Docs: a point in the topic
# en: A target that resolves to nothing is reported in the game's log rather than stopping anything, so a mistyped name shows up as an action that quietly does nothing.
docs.targetPicker.targetResolvesNothingReported = 指向不到任何东西的目标只会记进游戏日志，而不会中断什么，所以名字打错时表现为一个默默什么都不做的动作。

# Docs: a point in the topic
# en: In a condition there is no log line for it: an object that cannot be found reads the same as one switched off. Negate therefore means off or absent, not off — so a mistyped target in a negated condition passes rather than complaining.
docs.targetPicker.conditionThereNoLog = 在条件里连这条日志也没有：找不到的对象读起来和被关闭的对象一模一样。因此取反的含义是「关闭或不存在」，而不是「关闭」——于是取反条件里打错的目标会通过，而不会提出抗议。

docs.translations.files = 每种语言一个文本文件，按语言命名：es.txt、pt-BR.txt、zh-Hans.txt。每一行都是「键 = 文本」，上方的注释里写着它所依据的英文原文。任何文本编辑器都能打开，在 Notepad++ 里做「全部替换」也很安全：「检查翻译」会找出被它改坏的键并把它们放回去。

# en: The plugin's Language setting, in BepInEx\config\treboy.starmakerstory.smsmodforge.packplugin.cfg, picks the language for ModForge's own words and for every pack. auto follows the language Windows is set to.
docs.translations.setting = 插件的 Language 设置位于 BepInEx\config\treboy.starmakerstory.smsmodforge.packplugin.cfg，它决定 ModForge 自身用语以及所有模组包所用的语言。auto 会跟随 Windows 设定的语言。

# Docs: a point in the topic
# en: The game itself is in English and stays so. Its fonts only draw Latin letters, so for Chinese, Japanese, Korean or Russian the plugin puts Windows' own font for that language behind them.
docs.translations.fonts = 游戏本身是英文的，而且会保持英文。它的字体只能绘制拉丁字母，所以对于中文、日文、韩文或俄文，插件会把 Windows 自带的对应语言字体垫在后面。

# Docs: a point in the topic
# en: ModForge's own words in the game - the pack list on the main menu, the save warning - come from the same translation file as the editor's, under [In the game]. Put the file in BepInEx\plugins\SMSModForge\Languages and players see them in that language.
docs.translations.gameWords = 游戏中 ModForge 自己的用语——主菜单上的模组包列表、存档提醒——与编辑器用语来自同一个翻译文件，位于 [In the game] 之下。把文件放进 BepInEx\plugins\SMSModForge\Languages，玩家就会看到该语言的版本。

# Docs: a heading inside the topic
# en: Worth knowing
docs.translations.heading.worthKnowing = 值得了解

# Docs: a point in the topic
# en: Translations that came with the editor were made by a machine, and say so in the Language menu until somebody checks them. Corrections are welcome: make them with Edit texts on screen, or in the file, and pass the file on.
docs.translations.machine = 编辑器自带的翻译由机器完成，在有人校对之前，“语言”菜单中会注明这一点。欢迎指正：用“在屏幕上编辑文字”或直接在文件中修改，然后把文件传给大家。

# Docs: a point in the topic
# en: What a pack stores does not change with the language: keys, names you gave things and the values conditions compare stay as you typed them.
docs.translations.storedStays = 模组包保存的内容不随语言变化：键名、你给各种东西起的名字，以及条件所比较的值，都保持你输入时的原样。

# Docs: a point in the topic
# en: Text you put into a variable and show with [PV:...] is not translated: it is data, and a condition may be comparing it.
docs.translations.variables = 你放进变量、再用 [PV:...] 显示出来的文本不会被翻译：它是数据，而且可能正被某个条件拿来比较。

# Tutorials: what the step says
# en: Every character needs at least one outfit, and every outfit needs a base sprite: the picture of them from the chest up. Point this one at one of the five practice busts. They live in TutorialArt/Busts, one folder each, and the base picture is the file whose name ends in Base00 — so Bust1 is TutorialArt/Busts/Bust1/Bust1Base00.png, and Bust2 through Bust5 follow the same pattern.\n\nAny of them works here. They differ in shape on purpose, which will matter when you paint a jiggle mask later; the fuller ones give you more to see. The other files in those folders are the blink, mouth and expression art, and a later tutorial uses them.\n\nBust art is 256 by 256 pixels, PNG, with a transparent background. Other sizes are scaled to fit rather than refused, but 256 is the only size whose pixels land exactly as you drew them, and anything that is not square gets transparent bars on two sides. When you come to draw your own, that is the shape to draw.
tutorial.firstSteps.giveThemFace.body = 每个角色至少需要一套服装，每套服装都需要一张基础精灵图：胸部以上的那张画。把这一张指向五张练习半身像中的一张。它们在 TutorialArt/Busts 里，各占一个文件夹，基础图就是文件名以 Base00 结尾的那个文件——所以 Bust1 是 TutorialArt/Busts/Bust1/Bust1Base00.png，Bust2 到 Bust5 也遵循同样的规律。\n\n这里用哪一张都行。它们的形状是故意做得不一样的，等你以后要画晃动遮罩时这一点就有意义了；更丰满的那几张能让你看得更清楚。那些文件夹里的其他文件是眨眼、嘴部和表情素材，后面的教程会用到。\n\n半身像素材是 256×256 像素的 PNG，背景透明。其他尺寸会被缩放适配而不是拒绝，但只有 256 这个尺寸能让像素完全按你画的那样落位，而任何非正方形的图都会在两侧补上透明条。等你自己动手画时，要画的就是这个规格。

tutorial.firstSteps.giveThemFace.hint = 使用「精灵图」下「基础图」旁边的「浏览」按钮。

# Tutorials: the heading of a step
# en: Say what this outfit has
tutorial.firstSteps.sayOutfitHas.title = 说明这套服装有些什么

# Tutorials: what the step says
# en: A bust can carry more than its base picture: a blink frame, four mouth frames that animate while it talks, and four expressions. The three tickboxes are how you DECLARE which of those exist — they are not features to switch on, they are you telling the game what art to go looking for.\n\nYou are not using any of them yet, so untick all three: Has Blink frame, Has Mouth frames, Has Expressions. Getting this wrong is worth understanding now, because it fails silently — a ticked box with no art behind it reads as a BROKEN outfit, and the game skips the whole character rather than skipping the blink. A missing character with no error is almost always this.\n\nLeave Mask empty. An empty mask means the bust does not move, which is a perfectly good answer and the one you want until you paint one.
tutorial.firstSteps.sayOutfitHas.body = 一张半身像可以带的不只是基础图：还有一帧眨眼、四帧说话时会动的嘴部，以及四种表情。那三个勾选框是你用来「声明」这些东西存不存在的——它们不是可以打开的功能，而是你在告诉游戏该去找哪些素材。\n\n你现在一个都还没用上，所以把三个都取消勾选：有眨眼帧、有嘴部帧、有表情。现在就把这一点弄明白很值得，因为它失败时不声不响——勾了框却没有对应素材，会被读作一套“损坏的”服装，于是游戏跳过的是整个角色，而不只是眨眼。角色不见了又没有任何报错，几乎总是这个原因。\n\n把「遮罩」留空。遮罩为空意味着半身像不会动，这是一个完全站得住脚的答案，在你画出遮罩之前也正是你想要的。

# Tutorials: the nudge shown when a step has been waiting a while
# en: Two tickboxes in the Sprites box, one in Expressions just below it.
tutorial.firstSteps.sayOutfitHas.hint = 「精灵图」框里有两个勾选框，正下方的「表情」里还有一个。

# Tutorials: the heading of a step

tutorial.firstSteps.pack.title = 这就是一个模组包

# Tutorials: what the step says
# en: Save it, and File then Export pack bundles the folder into a single .smspack — the file the game loads. Drop that into the Mods folder in your game folder, beside the game's .exe, and it is installed.\n\nExport is the quick loop, for trying your own work in the game. Use it as often as you like: it changes nothing about the pack itself.\n\nThere is nothing to see in the game yet, because a character only appears once something gives them a line.
tutorial.firstSteps.pack.body = 保存它，然后「文件」再「导出模组包」，就会把这个文件夹打包成单个 .smspack——也就是游戏加载的那个文件。把它丢进游戏文件夹里、与游戏 .exe 并列的 Mods 文件夹，就算装好了。\n\n导出是快速循环，用来在游戏里试你自己的成果。想用多少次都行：它完全不会改动模组包本身。\n\n此刻游戏里还没什么可看的，因为角色要等到有东西给他一句台词才会现身。

# Tutorials: the heading of a step
# en: Giving it to somebody else
tutorial.firstSteps.givingSomebodyElse.title = 把它交给别人

# Tutorials: what the step says
# en: File then Publish for players is the other end of that. It checks the pack over first and says so if anything is broken, then writes a zip holding one thing: your pack, already sitting in a Mods folder. Whoever downloads it extracts that into their game folder and is finished — there is no step left for them to get wrong, which is where most mods are lost. Nothing else is in the archive, so installing two packs never asks anybody to overwrite anything.\n\nIt opens the folder it wrote to afterwards, so the file is never somewhere you have to go looking for.
tutorial.firstSteps.givingSomebodyElse.body = 「文件」再「发布给玩家」是这件事的另一端。它会先把模组包检查一遍，有问题就告诉你，然后生成一个只装了一样东西的 zip：你的模组包，而且已经放在一个 Mods 文件夹里。下载的人把它解压到自己的游戏文件夹就完事了——没有留下任何一步可以让他做错，而大多数模组正是折在这一步上。压缩包里没有别的东西，所以装两个模组包永远不会要求谁覆盖什么。\n\n完成后它会打开写入的那个文件夹，所以文件绝不会落在你还得费力去找的地方。

# Tutorials: the heading of a step
# en: The language it is written in
tutorial.firstSteps.writtenIn.title = 它所用的语言

# Tutorials: what the step says
# en: Written in, on this tab, says which language your pack's own words are in. It matters once the pack is translated: translations are made from it, and a player whose language has no translation reads the pack in it.\n\nWhen you export or publish, ModForge offers to translate by machine whatever is not yet in every language it has. Only what is still untranslated is sent, and a line you corrected yourself stays as you wrote it. To read or correct a translation, pick its language under Editing in, at the right end of the tabs, and edit as usual — it is saved with the pack.
tutorial.firstSteps.writtenIn.body = 此标签页上的“编写语言”说明你的模组包本身的文字是用哪种语言写的。模组包被翻译后它就很重要：翻译以它为基础，而没有自己语言翻译的玩家会用这种语言阅读模组包。\n\n导出或发布时，ModForge 会提议用机器翻译还没有覆盖其所有语言的内容。只发送仍未翻译的内容，你亲自改过的行会保持你写的样子。要阅读或修改某个翻译，请在标签页右端的“编辑语言”中选择它的语言，然后照常编辑——它会随模组包一起保存。

# Tutorials: the heading of a step
# en: The number beside your pack
tutorial.firstSteps.numberBesidePack.title = 模组包旁边的那个数字

# Tutorials: what the step says
# en: Publishing also moves the pack's version, and only publishing does. Saving does not, and neither does exporting: a version says what players were given, and an afternoon of saving gives them nothing.\n\nIt moves on its own, by what actually changed since your last release. Something new — a character, a room, a conversation — moves the middle number. A change to something that was already there moves the last one. The first is yours alone: type it into the Version box when you decide a release is a new thing rather than more of the old one.\n\nA place of your own is next: it builds a room and puts a door to it in the bedroom you wake up in, and every tutorial after that goes through the same door.
tutorial.firstSteps.numberBesidePack.body = 发布还会推进模组包的版本，而且只有发布才会。保存不会，导出也不会：版本说明的是交到玩家手里的是什么，而保存了一下午并没有给他们任何东西。\n\n它会自行推进，依据的是自你上次发布以来实际发生的改动。新增的东西——一个角色、一个房间、一段对话——会推进中间那位。已有内容发生改动则推进最后一位。第一位只属于你：当你认定这次发布是一件新东西、而不是旧东西的延续时，就在「版本」框里自己把它写上。\n\n接下来是一个属于你自己的地点：它会搭出一个房间，并在你醒来的那间卧室里放一扇通往它的门，之后的每一篇教程都从这扇门进去。

# Tutorials: the heading of a step

tutorial.dressingTheRoom.roomMoreThanTwo.title = 房间不只是两张图

# Tutorials: what the step says
# en: The back and front layers are the room itself. Everything ELSE in it is a GameObject: its own picture, at its own position, with its own place in the stack — and, unlike the layers, something a dialogue or a rule can switch on and off while the game runs.\n\nThat is how a room changes. A door that opens is two objects, one switched off. A coat left on a chair is an object that appears once a conversation has happened. A lamp that comes on at night is the same trick again.\n\nObject art is NOT a level layer, so it is not 2048 by 1136. Draw it at whatever size the thing really is, on a transparent background; it is placed in the room rather than filling it.
tutorial.dressingTheRoom.roomMoreThanTwo.body = 后景和前景图层就是房间本身。房间里其他的一切都是 GameObject：有自己的图、自己的位置、在层叠中自己的位次——而且和图层不同，它是对话或规则可以在游戏运行时开关的东西。\n\n房间就是这样发生变化的。一扇会开的门是两个对象，其中一个是关着的。搭在椅子上的外套，是某段对话发生之后才出现的对象。到了夜里亮起的台灯，又是同一个把戏。\n\n对象的美术素材不是关卡图层，所以它不是 2048×1136。按那样东西实际的尺寸去画，背景透明；它是被摆进房间里的，而不是把房间填满。

# Tutorials: what the step says

tutorial.dressingTheRoom.decideStandsFront.body = 排序值就是层叠顺序。后景图层在 -12，前景图层在 -10，所以排序值为 -11 的对象就夹在两者之间：在前景图层的家具之后，在它背后的墙之前。任何高于 -10 的东西都会盖住整个房间。\n\n新对象从 0 开始，也就是盖在一切之上。把它设成 -11，看预览把它放进房间里，而不是摆在房间上面。

# Tutorials: what the step says
# en: An object that starts switched off is drawn faded, so you can still position it — the game will draw nothing there until something turns it on. tutorial.dressingTheRoom.previewTelling.body = 初始处于关闭状态的对象会以变暗的方式绘制，好让你仍然能摆放它——在有东西开启它之前，游戏在那里什么都不会画。「初始未激活的对象变暗」可以在你工作时关掉这种显示。\n\n位于关闭的父对象之下的一切也是如此：游戏一点都不会画，所以预览会把它们全都变暗。如果你的一整组对象都发白了，原因就在这里。

# Tutorials: what the step says
# en: You have already built one: a navigator button on the bedroom's strip, which is a door from one room to another. A place on the map is a destination in its own right rather than a room reached through another one.\n\nThe map is not open from everywhere, mind: the player reaches it by going to the Garage, into the Car, and pressing Drive. So a map button suits somewhere they would deliberately travel to, and a navigator button suits somewhere they walk into from next door. Most places want one or the other, not both.
tutorial.onTheWorldMap.twoWaysReachRoom.body = 其中一种你已经搭好了：卧室导航条上的一个按钮，也就是从一个房间通往另一个房间的门。它管用，而且对于藏在另一个地点「后面」的地方来说形态正合适——店铺后面的办公室、走廊边上的卧室。\n\n世界地图是另一种方式，含义也不一样。地图上的地点是一个独立的目的地，而不是要穿过另一个房间才到得了的屋子。\n\n不过要注意，地图并不是随处都能打开的：玩家得先去车库、上车，再按「驾驶」。所以地图按钮适合玩家会特意前往的地方，而导航按钮适合他从隔壁走进去的地方。大多数地点要的是其中之一，而不是两个都要。

# Tutorials: what the step says
# en: So far every node in your dialogue runs when play reaches it. tutorial.linesThatChoose.notEveryLineShould.body = 到目前为止，你对话里的每个节点只要播放走到就会运行。一段能对什么做出反应的对话需要的恰恰相反：有些台词有时候不该播放。\n\n这正是节点自身那个「条件」框的用途，而且它的表现会随节点所处的位置分成两种。普通节点的条件不成立时会被「跳过」——播放继续走向下一个。直接位于「选择」之下的节点则根本不会被摆出来：玩家压根看不到那个选项，而不是看到一个变灰的选项。

# Tutorials: the heading of a step
# en: Gate it on something real
tutorial.linesThatChoose.gateSomethingReal.title = 让它取决于真实存在的东西

# Tutorials: what the step says
# en: Add a condition to that node with + Add condition, then finish it — an empty condition row is not a gate, it is a blank that always passes.\n\nSet its Type to GameObjectActive. The row then asks the same three things in the same order the Set-Active action asks them: Category, Level, Target. That is deliberate — a condition reads back exactly what that action sets, so it addresses the object the same way.\n\nSet Category to GameObjects, since the object lives inside a place. Set Level to your place: the Target dropdown stays disabled until you do, because it lists that level's objects and nothing else. Then pick the object you put in the room and left switched off.\n\nDoing this against something you already built matters. The object is genuinely off, so the line genuinely will not play — and when a rule switches the object on later, the line starts appearing on its own. The conversation is reading the state of the room.
tutorial.linesThatChoose.gateSomethingReal.body = 用 + 添加条件给那个节点加一个条件，然后把它填完整——空白的条件行不是门槛，它是一处永远通过的空白。\n\n把它的「类型」设为 GameObjectActive。这一行随后会按设为激活的那个动作完全相同的顺序，问同样的三件事：类别、关卡、目标。这是有意为之——条件读取的正是那个动作所写入的内容，所以它寻址对象的方式也一模一样。\n\n把「类别」设为 GameObjects，因为这个对象住在某个地点里面。把「关卡」设为你的地点：在你设好之前，「目标」下拉框一直是禁用的，因为它只列出那个关卡里的对象。然后挑出你放进房间又留着没开的那个对象。\n\n拿你已经建好的东西来做这一步很重要。那个对象确确实实是关着的，所以这句台词确确实实不会播放——而等日后某条规则把对象开启，这句台词就会自己开始出现。这段对话读的是房间的状态。

# Tutorials: the nudge shown when a step has been waiting a while
# en: Type = GameObjectActive, then Category, Level and Target below it.
tutorial.linesThatChoose.gateSomethingReal.hint = 类型 = GameObjectActive，然后是它下面的类别、关卡和目标。

# Tutorials: the heading of a step
# en: Conditions do not stop at objects
tutorial.linesThatChoose.conditionsDoNotStop.title = 条件不止于对象

# Tutorials: what the step says
# en: The same box offers everything the pack can ask about: which place is on screen, what a variable holds, whether it is raining, a percentage rolled once a day. Every condition in the list has to pass, and an empty list always passes — which is why a node with no conditions always plays.\n\nAny condition can also be negated, which is usually shorter than writing the opposite one.
tutorial.linesThatChoose.conditionsDoNotStop.body = 同一个框里提供了模组包能询问的一切：屏幕上是哪个地点、某个变量装着什么、是否在下雨、一个每天掷一次的百分比。列表里的每个条件都必须通过，而空列表永远通过——这正是没有条件的节点总会播放的原因。\n\n任何条件也都可以取反，这通常比写出相反的那一个更省事。

# Tutorials: what the step says
# en: A conversation is rarely one voice. The Actor field on a node says who speaks it, and it holds from that node onward until another one changes it — you do not set it per line.\n\nEvery pack has a speaker it did not create: the player. Add a node and set its Actor to the player, and the line is the player talking back. Any mod addressing you reaches that same character, which is why its name and colour are fixed and yours to use rather than define.
tutorial.linesThatChoose.someoneElseRoom.body = 一段对话很少只有一个声音。节点上的「演员」字段说明由谁来说这句话，并且从那个节点起一直有效，直到另一个节点更改它——不必逐行设置。\n\n每个模组包都有一个自己没创造的说话者：玩家。添加一个节点，把它的「演员」设为玩家，这句台词就是玩家的回话。任何对你说话的模组都指向同一个角色，这也是为什么他的名字和颜色是固定的，供你使用，而不由你定义。

# en: Add a node, write a line, then set Actor to player.

# Tutorials: the heading of a step
# en: Letting one option say more
tutorial.linesThatChoose.lettingOneOptionSay.title = 让其中一个选项多说几句

# Tutorials: what the step says
# en: Last tutorial you gave one option Exit and let the other fall through to your closing line. Both are still one line long. Real dialogue is lopsided — one answer earns a reaction, the other does not — and the branch that reacts still has to end up somewhere, or you write the ending twice.\n\nA TAG is a name you give a node so another node can send play to it. Two fields do it. Tag, on the node being aimed AT - tick it to give the node one: a short word, yours to choose, and it is a label rather than anything the player sees. Then, on the node doing the aiming: set it to Jump, and a Jump to box appears listing the tags in this dialogue.\n\nBuild it in that order — the tag first, so it is there to be picked. Tag your closing line, the one you added last tutorial, with something like ending. Then take the option you did NOT set to Exit, add a Child under it, and write the reaction that answer deserves. On that child set Then to Jump, and choose ending in the Jump to box.\n\nPlay now runs the option, the reaction, and then lands on the closing line. The other option still ends where it ended. One ending, written once, reached two ways — and nothing repeats, because every jump here goes forward.
tutorial.linesThatChoose.lettingOneOptionSay.body = 上一篇教程里，你给一个选项设了退出，让另一个自然落到收尾台词。两个都还只有一行。真实的对话是不对称的——一个回答值得一句回应，另一个不值得——而作出回应的那条分支最终也得落到某个地方，否则你就得把结尾写两遍。\n\n「标签」是你给某个节点起的名字，好让另一个节点把播放送到它那里。要用两个字段。「标签」在被指向的那个节点上——勾选它就能给节点一个标签：一个短词，你自己定，它是内部的记号，玩家看不到。然后，在发出指向的那个节点上：把它设为跳转，就会出现一个「跳转到」框，列出本段对话里的标签。\n\n按这个顺序来搭——先写标签，它才会在那里可供挑选。给你上一篇教程加的那句收尾台词打个标签，比如 ending。然后找到你「没有」设为退出的那个选项，给它加一个子节点，写上那个回答应得的回应。在那个子节点上把「然后」设为跳转，并在「跳转到」框里选 ending。\n\n现在播放会走过这个选项、这句回应，然后落到收尾台词。另一个选项仍然在原来的地方结束。一个结尾，只写一遍，两条路都能到——而且什么都不会重复，因为这里的跳转都是往前走的。

# Tutorials: the nudge shown when a step has been waiting a while
# en: Tag the closing line, then + Child on the non-Exit option, set its Then to Jump and pick that tag.
tutorial.linesThatChoose.lettingOneOptionSay.hint = 先给收尾台词打标签，然后在没有设为退出的那个选项上 + 子节点，把它的「然后」设为跳转，并选那个标签。

# Tutorials: the heading of a step
# en: Jumping backwards on purpose
tutorial.linesThatChoose.jumpingBackwardsPurpose.title = 有意往回跳

# Tutorials: what the step says
# en: Forward is not the only direction, and backwards is not a mistake. Jumping back to a Choice is one of the most useful shapes there is, and the game itself is full of it: a menu where each option answers and then returns, except one that carries the conversation on. Ask about the weather, come back. Ask about her sister, come back. Say you should get going, and that one continues.\n\nTo build it, tag the Choice node itself, then give the last line of each returning branch a jump to that tag. The option that leaves simply does not jump — it continues, or exits.\n\nThe one thing to be sure of is a way out. If every option comes back, the player cannot leave; at least one has to not return. Put that option in the menu from the start rather than behind a condition, or a player who fails the condition is stuck in a conversation with no exit.\n\nAnd give a tag to exactly one node. Two nodes carrying the same tag make every jump aimed at it ambiguous: play goes to whichever the game reaches first, which is not something you chose and may not stay the same.
tutorial.linesThatChoose.jumpingBackwardsPurpose.body = 往前不是唯一的方向，往回也不是错误。跳回一个「选择」是最有用的结构之一，游戏本身里到处都是：一个菜单，每个选项答完就回来，只有一个把对话往下带。问问天气，回来。问问她妹妹，回来。说你该走了，这一个就继续。\n\n要搭出来，先给「选择」节点本身打标签，再给每条会返回的分支的最后一句台词设一个跳到那个标签的跳转。要离开的那个选项干脆不跳——它继续，或者退出。\n\n唯一要确保的是留一条出路。如果每个选项都回来，玩家就走不掉；至少得有一个不返回。把那个选项从一开始就放进菜单里，而不要藏在条件后面，否则没通过条件的玩家就困在一段没有出口的对话里了。\n\n还有，同一个标签只给一个节点。两个节点带着同一个标签，会让每个指向它的跳转都变得含糊：播放会去到游戏先找到的那一个，那并不是你选定的，而且未必一直不变。

# Tutorials: what the step says
# en: It records how much of an effect each part of a sprite gets, and it holds three separate layers. Bounce moves those pixels up and down. tutorial.makingItMove.maskNotArtwork.body = 它记录的是精灵图的每一部分受到多少效果，并且包含三个独立的层。弹跳让那些像素上下移动。波动让它们左右滑动，形成一道沿着精灵图向上传播的波。噪声让它们不规则地散动。第四个数值——总体强度——同时缩放这三者，所以黑色是不动，越亮动得越多。画遮罩，就是在决定半身像哪里动、朝哪动、动多少。

# Tutorials: the heading of a step
# en: What the Jiggle numbers do
tutorial.makingItMove.jiggleNumbersDo.title = 晃动的那些数值做什么

# Tutorials: what the step says
# en: The mask says WHERE the sprite moves; these say how. Strength is how far the pixels travel and Speed how fast the cycle runs. Wave frequency is how many waves fit across the sprite, so a low number sways and a high one ripples. The three Noise settings keep it from ticking like a metronome — Scale is how fine the grain is, Speed how fast it drifts, Strength how much of it shows through. Tint multiplies the sprite's colour and is almost always left white. The defaults are a sensible bust: change one at a time and watch the preview, because the numbers mean far less than what you see.
tutorial.makingItMove.jiggleNumbersDo.body = 遮罩说的是精灵图「哪里」动；这些说的是怎么动。强度是像素移动的幅度，速度是循环跑得多快。波频是精灵图宽度上能容下几道波，所以数值小是摇曳，数值大是涟漪。三个噪声设置让它不至于像节拍器那样机械——噪声缩放是颗粒的粗细，噪声速度是它漂移得多快，噪声强度是它透出来多少。着色会与精灵图的颜色相乘，几乎总是留白。默认值就是一个合理的半身像：一次只改一个并盯着预览，因为数值本身远不如你看到的效果重要。

# Tutorials: the heading of a step
# en: The droplets, over here too
tutorial.makingItMove.dropletsOverHereToo.title = 水珠，这边也有

# Tutorials: what the step says
# en: Under Jiggle there is a Particles box with one tickbox in it. The game's Wet particle preset — the droplets it uses for swim and shower art — is attached to every pack bust whether you ask for it or not; the tickbox only decides whether it is PLAYING when the bust appears.\n\nLeave it off for an ordinary outfit, or a dry character talks to the player in the rain. Tick it on the swimsuit or just-out-of-the-shower variant, which is the whole reason it exists.\n\nNPCs have the same setting on their own tab, with one difference worth knowing now: for an NPC the emitter's POSITION is set per placement rather than on the definition, because the same figure can stand in more than one room.
tutorial.makingItMove.dropletsOverHereToo.body = 「晃动」下面有一个「粒子」框，里面只有一个勾选框。游戏的「湿身」粒子预设——它用于泳装和出浴素材的那些水珠——无论你要不要，都挂在每一张模组包半身像上；这个勾选框只决定半身像出现时它是不是正在「播放」。\n\n普通服装请让它关着，否则一个干爽的角色会在雨里跟玩家说话。在泳装或刚出浴的那套上勾选它，这也正是它存在的全部理由。\n\nNPC 在自己的页签里有同样的设置，但有一点现在就值得知道：对 NPC 而言，发射器的「位置」是按每次摆放来设定的，而不是写在定义里，因为同一个人物可以站在不止一个房间里。

# Tutorials: the heading of a step
# en: What the preview can show you
tutorial.makingItMove.previewCanShow.title = 预览能告诉你什么

# Tutorials: what the step says
# en: Breathing is already on, and it is the mask doing its work — the fastest way to tell whether you painted too much. Depth beside it is how pronounced that idle motion is.\n\nThe other controls drive the overlays you added last tutorial: Blinking cycles the blink frame, Yapping runs the mouth, Mouth frame holds one frame still so you can look at it, and Expression swaps in one of the four faces. Turn them on while the mask is running — that combination is what the player actually sees.\n\nWatch the face while you do, because the mask does not reach it. Only the base sprite is displaced; the blink, the mouth and the expressions sit on top of it exactly where they were drawn and do not move at all.\n\nSo paint across the face and the face slides out from under its own eyes and mouth. Nothing looks wrong until an overlay is showing, which is why it is easy to miss: turn Blinking and Yapping on and the drift is obvious.\n\nThat is the whole reason most busts move at the chest and the hair and leave the face alone. Keep the mask off it, or dark enough there that nothing separates.
tutorial.makingItMove.previewCanShow.body = 「呼吸」本来就是开着的，那正是遮罩在起作用——也是判断你有没有涂过头的最快办法。旁边的「深度」是这种待机动作的明显程度。\n\n其余的控件驱动你上一篇教程加的那些叠加图：「眨眼」循环眨眼帧，「说话」让嘴动起来，「嘴部帧」把某一帧定住供你端详，「表情」则换上四张脸中的一张。在遮罩运行时把它们打开——那个组合才是玩家真正看到的样子。\n\n一边看一边盯着脸，因为遮罩够不到脸。被位移的只有基础精灵图；眨眼、嘴部和表情就叠在上面、停在画好的位置，一动也不动。\n\n所以只要你在脸上涂了遮罩，脸就会从自己的眼睛和嘴底下滑出去。在叠加图显示出来之前一切看着都没问题，这正是它容易被忽略的原因：把「眨眼」和「说话」打开，错位就一目了然了。\n\n这就是为什么大多数半身像只在胸口和头发上动，而放过脸部。把遮罩从脸上挪开，或者在那里涂得足够暗，让什么都不会分离。

tutorial.makingItMove.thenJudgeGame.title = 然后在游戏里下判断

# Tutorials: what the step says

tutorial.makingItMove.thenJudgeGame.body = 导出并走进你的房间，让角色带着运行中的遮罩说话。预览和游戏用的是同一套代码和同样的数值，但只有在玩家实际看到的尺寸下、在台词进行当中，动得太多才会露出马脚。

# Tutorials: what the step says
# en: Turn on Reflection. It draws a mirrored copy beneath the pose, and it is what makes a figure look like it is standing on a wet street or a polished floor rather than in front of one.\n\nIt is off by default because most floors are not reflective, and a reflection on a carpet reads as a mistake. Alpha is how visible it is — the game's own reflections are a faint wash, not a second character — and Y offset moves it to meet the feet rather than the middle of the sprite.\n\nYou do not have to guess that offset. Once reflection is on, a Reflection chip appears in the preview toolbar on the Places tab alongside Body, Shadow, Blink and Wet — pick it and drag the reflection up or down against the actual floor of the actual room.\n\nIt drags vertically and nothing else, because that offset is the only number there is: the mirror is dropped a full pose height automatically, and this is the correction on top. tutorial.npcsThatBelong.standThemSomething.body = 打开「倒影」。它会在姿势下方画一份镜像副本，正是它让人物看起来是站在湿漉漉的街道或抛光地面「上」，而不是站在它前面。\n\n它默认是关的，因为大多数地面并不反光，而地毯上的倒影读起来就像出了错。「Alfa」是它有多明显——游戏自己的倒影是一层淡淡的影子，而不是第二个角色——「Y 偏移」则把它挪到与双脚相接的位置，而不是精灵图的中间。\n\n这个偏移你不用靠猜。倒影一打开，「地点」页签的预览工具条上就会出现一个「倒影」标签，和身体、影子、眨眼、湿身并列——选中它，对着真实房间里真实的地面把倒影上下拖动。\n\n它只能竖直拖动，别的都不行，因为那个偏移是唯一的数值：镜像会自动下移整整一个姿势的高度，而这是在此之上的修正。而且与另外四项不同，它属于 NPC 而不属于摆放，所以在这里挪动它，会影响那个 NPC 所在的每一个房间。选中它时工具条上会这么写。

# en: Both placements now reflect and blink, because both are the same definition — and they stand in different spots under different names, because a placement is its own thing.\n\nThat is the shape to remember: art and behaviour on the NPC, position and identity on the placement. tutorial.npcsThatBelong.roomPeople.body = 现在两次摆放都会有倒影、都会眨眼，因为它们是同一个定义；而它们站在不同的位置、用着不同的名字，因为摆放本身是独立的一件事。\n\n这个结构值得记住：美术和行为在 NPC 上，位置和身份在摆放上。人群是一个定义配许多次摆放；而一整个角色阵容则是许多个定义。

# Tutorials: what the step says

tutorial.soundInARoom.otherWayFireOne.body = 模式并不是唯一的路子。节点可以在开始时或结束时挂一个 PlaySFX 动作，按运行时名称点名那个音效——还可以用「音量」覆盖默认值，用「延迟」让它晚一点再响。\n\n两者做的是同一件事，区别恰恰只有一点：模式必须写「在」台词里，所以玩家会连着别的内容一起读到 *door*。动作则不必，所以声音可以叠在一句毫无异样的台词上。其余全都一样，包括下一步要讲的随机变体。\n\n舞台提示本来就该出现在剧本里时用模式，不该出现时用动作。现在就在同一段对话里加一个。

# Tutorials: what the step says
# en: One more thing with no field for it. Put extra recordings beside the first with _1, _2, _3 on the end of the same name, and the game picks between them at random each time the effect plays.\n\nAudio/Door.wav picks up Audio/Door_1.wav and Audio/Door_2.wav on its own. Number them without gaps — counting stops at the first missing number, so _1, _2, _4 loads two of the three. The extensions do not have to match, so a WAV alongside an OGG is fine.\n\nIt is the difference between a door that sounds the same every time and one that does not. Both routes draw from the same set: a pattern in a line and a PlaySFX action pick a variant the same way.
tutorial.soundInARoom.moreThanOneTake.body = 还有一件没有对应字段的事。把额外的录音放在第一个旁边，用同样的名字并在末尾加 _1、_2、_3，游戏每次播放这个音效时就会在它们之间随机挑一条。\n\nAudio/Door.wav 会自行收集 Audio/Door_1.wav 和 Audio/Door_2.wav。编号不要跳号——收集会在第一个缺失的编号处停止，所以 _1、_2、_4 只会载入三条里的两条。扩展名不必一致，所以 OGG 旁边放一个 WAV 也没问题。\n\n这就是一扇门每次听起来都一样、和每次都不太一样之间的区别。两条路子取的是同一组素材：台词里的模式和 PlaySFX 动作，挑变体的方式完全相同。

# Tutorials: the heading of a step
# en: Putting things in and asking what is there
tutorial.remembering.puttingThingsAskingThere.title = 往里放东西，以及问问里面有什么

# Tutorials: what the step says
# en: A list has its own verbs, and they are the whole feature.\n\nTo CHANGE it, from a node action: Add to list appends a value, Remove from list takes the first matching one back out, and Clear list empties it. Adding the same value twice really does store it twice — nothing de-duplicates for you, so check before you add if that matters.\n\nTo ASK about it, from conditions: ListContains passes when a particular value is in there — negate it for "has not been used yet", which is the shape you want on a menu option. ListCount compares how many entries there are against a number, so equals zero means empty and negating that means something is in it.\n\nTwo more read it: Random from list picks one entry and writes it into another variable, and List count writes the size into an Int. Both are operations on the Variable action rather than actions of their own.\n\nAdd one to your list from a node now — an action on finish, Add to list, naming the list and a value.
tutorial.remembering.puttingThingsAskingThere.body = 列表有自己的一套动词，而它们就是这个功能的全部。\n\n要「改动」它，用节点动作：「添加到列表」在末尾追加一个值，「从列表移除」取走第一个匹配的，「清空列表」把它倒空。同一个值加两次是真的会存两份——没有谁替你去重，所以如果这很要紧，加之前先检查。\n\n要「询问」它，用条件：ListContains 在某个特定值在里面时通过——取反就是「还没用过」，这正是菜单选项上想要的形态。ListCount 把条目数量和一个数字作比较，所以等于零就是空，对它取反就是里面有东西。\n\n还有两个会读它：「Random from list」挑出一个条目并写进另一个变量，「List count」把数量写进一个 Int。这两个都是 Variable 动作下的操作，而不是独立的动作。\n\n现在就从某个节点往你的列表里加一个：一个结束时的动作，「添加到列表」，指明列表和一个值。

# Tutorials: the nudge shown when a step has been waiting a while
# en: + Add action on a node, Type = AddToList, then the list and a value.
tutorial.remembering.puttingThingsAskingThere.hint = 在某个节点上 + 添加动作，类型 = AddToList，然后填列表和一个值。

# Tutorials: the heading of a step
# en: The list you will actually use it for
tutorial.remembering.listWillActuallyUse.title = 你真正会用到它的那种列表

# Tutorials: what the step says
# en: The pattern worth remembering, because it turns up constantly: a Choice whose options each add their own name to a list and gate themselves on NOT containing it.\n\nThe player sees the topics they have not asked about yet, the menu shrinks as they work through it, and when the last one goes the choice is empty — so keep one option outside the pattern that always shows and ends the conversation.\n\nWritten with Bools that is a variable and a condition per topic. Written with a list it is the same two rows on every option, and adding a seventh topic costs nothing.
tutorial.remembering.listWillActuallyUse.body = 这个套路值得记住，因为它会反复出现：一个「选择」，每个选项都把自己的名字加进一个列表，同时以「列表里还没有它」作为自己的条件。\n\n玩家看到的是他还没问过的话题，菜单随着他一个个问下去而缩短；当最后一个也没了，这个选择就空了——所以留一个不走这个套路的选项，始终显示，并用来结束对话。\n\n用 Bool 来写，那是每个话题一个变量加一个条件。用列表来写，每个选项上都是同样两行，而加第七个话题不花任何代价。

# Tutorials: the heading of a step
# en: Watch it change something
tutorial.remembering.watchChangeSomething.title = 看着它改变些什么

# Tutorials: what the step says
# en: Export and go through. Check the wallpaper is locked, have the conversation that sets your variable, then check again. That before-and-after is the whole point of state, and it is the one thing no preview can show you.
tutorial.remembering.watchChangeSomething.body = 导出并走进去。先确认壁纸是锁着的，再把那段会给变量赋值的对话走一遍，然后再确认一次。这个前后对比正是「状态」的全部意义，也是任何预览都没法给你看的唯一一件事。

[Tutorial: Putting a value into a line]

# Tutorials: a tutorial's name
# en: Putting a value into a line
tutorial.valuesInText.title = 把值写进台词里

# Tutorials: the line under a tutorial's name
# en: Show a variable in dialogue, and use one in place of a typed-in value.
tutorial.valuesInText.summary = 在对话里显示一个变量，并用变量代替手动填写的值。

# Tutorials: the heading of a step
# en: Four ways, and they are not interchangeable
tutorial.valuesInText.fourWaysTheyNot.title = 四种写法，而且不能互换

# Tutorials: what the step says
# en: You have a variable. So far it can only gate things — a line plays or it does not. It can also be SHOWN, and used in place of values you would otherwise type.\n\nThere are four notations and each works in one place:\n\n[PV:name] puts one of YOUR variables into dialogue text or a button label. {PC}, {M}, {D} and {B} put the GAME's names into dialogue text. $name uses a variable's value in an action or condition box instead of a fixed one. {item} stands for the current value in a rule that repeats over a list.\n\nUsing the wrong one is quiet: the text simply shows the notation you typed, because nothing was there to replace it.
tutorial.valuesInText.fourWaysTheyNot.body = 你已经有了一个变量。到目前为止它只能充当门槛——一句台词播放，或者不播放。它还可以被「显示」出来，也可以用来代替你本来要手动填的值。\n\n一共有四种写法，各自只在一个地方起作用：\n\n[PV:name] 把「你的」某个变量放进对话文本或按钮标签里。{PC}、{M}、{D} 和 {B} 把「游戏的」名字放进对话文本里。$name 在动作或条件框里用变量的值代替固定值。{item} 在按列表重复的规则里代表当前的那个值。\n\n用错了是悄无声息的：文本会原样显示你写下的那串记号，因为没有任何东西可以替换它。

# Tutorials: the heading of a step
# en: Show your variable in a line
tutorial.valuesInText.showVariableLine.title = 在台词里显示你的变量

# Tutorials: what the step says
# en: Go to your conversation and put [PV:name] into a node's text, with the name of the variable you declared — square brackets, PV, a colon, the name, and a closing bracket, spelled exactly.\n\nThe line will read the variable's value where the token sits. That is how a character says a number back to the player, or a name the player chose earlier in your own pack.
tutorial.valuesInText.showVariableLine.body = 打开你的对话，在某个节点的文本里写上 [PV:name]，把 name 换成你声明的那个变量名——方括号、PV、冒号、名字、右方括号，一个字符都不能差。\n\n这一行会在标记所在的位置读出变量的值。角色把一个数字回给玩家，或者说出玩家早先在你自己模组包里选定的一个名字，靠的就是这个。

# Tutorials: the nudge shown when a step has been waiting a while
# en: Select a node and add [PV:yourVariable] to its Text.
tutorial.valuesInText.showVariableLine.hint = 选中一个节点，在它的「文本」里加上 [PV:yourVariable]。

# Tutorials: the heading of a step
# en: The names the player chose
tutorial.valuesInText.namesPlayerChose.title = 玩家自己选定的那些名字

# Tutorials: what the step says
# en: The game has names of its own, and they are not yours to set. {PC} is the player's name. The other three stand for the family, one token each:\n\n{M} is what this player calls Anna. {D} is what they call Josef. {B} is what they call Adrian.\n\nEach player chose those words at the start, so they differ from save to save — which is the whole reason the tokens exist.\n\nSo write {M} rather than Mom, or Anna. A line that spells it out says that one word to everyone, including the player who chose something else, and they cannot tell your line from the game losing their choice. Validate warns about it if you forget.\n\nThose four are the ones known to work. What makes a braced word one of these is not documented, so treat any other as unsupported until you have watched it resolve in game.
tutorial.valuesInText.namesPlayerChose.body = 游戏有自己的一套名字，那不是由你来定的。{PC} 是玩家的名字。另外三个代表那一家人，各占一个标记：\n\n{M} 是这位玩家对 Anna 的称呼。{D} 是他对 Josef 的称呼。{B} 是他对 Adrian 的称呼。\n\n每位玩家在开局时选定了这些词，所以它们因存档而异——这正是这些标记存在的全部理由。\n\n所以请写 {M}，而不要写「妈妈」或者 Anna。把称呼写死的台词，会对所有人都说同一个词，包括那些选了别的称呼的玩家；而他们分不清这是你的台词，还是游戏把他们的选择弄丢了。你要是忘了，「验证」会提醒你。\n\n这四个是已知可用的。一个花括号里的词凭什么算作其中之一并没有文档说明，所以在你亲眼看到它在游戏里被替换之前，请把其他任何写法都当作不受支持。

# Tutorials: the heading of a step
# en: A value you do not know yet
tutorial.valuesInText.valueDoNotKnow.title = 一个你此刻还不知道的值

# Tutorials: what the step says
# en: [PV:name] SHOWS a variable to the player. $name is the other direction: it hands the variable's value to an action or a condition, in place of the number or word you would otherwise type in. Nobody reads it — it never reaches the screen.\n\nWhy that matters: a typed-in value is decided now, while you are authoring. A $name value is decided later, while the game is running, and can be different every time.\n\nMake one and watch. Declare a String variable — call it LastPropShown — and leave its default empty. Then on some node, add TWO actions on finish. The first is a Variable action, Operation Set, writing the name of the prop you put in your room into LastPropShown. The second is Set-Active with its Target typed as $LastPropShown — one dollar sign, then the variable name, no brackets and no spaces.\n\nThe second action does not name the prop. It hides whatever the first one wrote down. Change what the first action writes — from a different node, or an integration rule — and the second acts on something else without being edited.\n\nThat is the shape it earns its keep in: one action that says "put back whatever was showing" instead of one action per object that might have been. It works in condition boxes too, so a gate can compare against a value chosen at runtime.\n\nOne trap: $$ is how you write a literal dollar sign, for the rare line where you want one.
tutorial.valuesInText.valueDoNotKnow.body = [PV:name] 是把变量「显示」给玩家看。$name 是反方向的：它把变量的值交给动作或条件，代替你本来要填的数字或词。没有人会读到它——它永远不会出现在屏幕上。\n\n这为什么重要：手填的值是现在、在你创作时定下的。$name 的值是之后、在游戏运行时定下的，而且每次都可能不同。\n\n做一个来看看。声明一个 String 变量——就叫 LastPropShown——默认值留空。然后在某个节点上加「两个」结束时的动作。第一个是 Variable 动作，操作为 Set，把你放进房间的那个道具的名字写进 LastPropShown。第二个是设为激活的动作，它的「目标」直接填 $LastPropShown——一个美元符号，紧接着变量名，不加括号也不加空格。\n\n第二个动作并没有点名那个道具。它隐藏的是第一个动作记下来的任何东西。改变第一个动作写入的内容——从另一个节点，或者从一条集成规则——第二个动作就会作用在别的东西上，而它自己一个字都不用改。\n\n这就是它真正体现价值的形态：用一个「把刚才显示着的那个放回去」的动作，取代为每一个可能显示过的对象各写一个动作。它在条件框里同样有效，所以门槛也可以拿运行时才决定的值来比较。\n\n一个坑：$$ 是书写字面美元符号的写法，留给那种偶尔真要写一个的台词。

# Tutorials: the nudge shown when a step has been waiting a while
# en: Add an action on finish, then type $ and your variable name into a value box.
tutorial.valuesInText.valueDoNotKnow.hint = 加一个结束时的动作，然后在某个取值框里输入 $ 加上你的变量名。

# Tutorials: the heading of a step
# en: And one for lists
tutorial.valuesInText.oneLists.title = 还有一种是给列表用的

# Tutorials: what the step says
# en: The fourth is for integration rules, which you will meet next. A rule can repeat over a list — every value in a List variable, or a few typed in — and {item} stands for whichever value it is running for at the time.\n\nThe name is yours: the box beside it sets the word, and item is only the default. One rule written once then does the work of six near-identical ones.
tutorial.valuesInText.oneLists.body = 第四种是给集成规则用的，你接下来就会遇到。规则可以在一个列表上重复运行——List 变量里的每个值，或者手写的几个值——而 {item} 代表它当次正在处理的那个值。\n\n名字由你定：旁边的框设定这个词，item 只是默认值。一条只写一遍的规则，就此顶得上六条几乎一模一样的规则。

# Tutorials: the heading of a step
# en: Which one goes where
tutorial.valuesInText.whichOneGoesWhere.title = 哪一种用在哪里

# Tutorials: what the step says
# en: Worth keeping straight, because none of them complains when it is in the wrong place:\n\n[PV:name] — your variables, in text and button labels.\n{PC} {M} {D} {B} — the game's names, in text.\n$name — your variables, in action and condition value boxes.\n{item} — the current value, inside a repeating rule.\n\nA token in the wrong place is shown to the player exactly as you typed it. If a line reads [PV:gold] in game, that is this.
tutorial.valuesInText.whichOneGoesWhere.body = 这个值得分清楚，因为用错地方时它们谁都不会吭声：\n\n[PV:name]——你的变量，用在文本和按钮标签里。\n{PC} {M} {D} {B}——游戏的名字，用在文本里。\n$name——你的变量，用在动作和条件的取值框里。\n{item}——当前的值，用在重复运行的规则里。\n\n用错地方的标记会原样显示给玩家，你怎么写它就怎么显示。如果游戏里有一行写着 [PV:gold]，就是这个原因。

# Tutorials: what the step says
# en: An effect does not need an action at all. Auto-trigger patterns is a list of words that fire it on their own whenever one of them shows up in a line, written between asterisks by convention, like *plap*. tutorial.rules.trickWorthKnowingAbout.body = 音效根本不需要动作。「自动触发模式」是一串词，只要其中之一出现在某行台词里，它们就会自行触发；按惯例写在星号之间，比如 *plap*。把额外的录音丢在第一个旁边，命名为 _1、_2 等等，游戏就会在它们之间随机挑选，这样常用的声音就不会听腻。这两件事从页签上都看不出来，这也是本步骤存在的唯一理由。

# Tutorials: what the step says
# en: Characters, places, conversations, art, memory and rules — and one door from the bedroom to go and stand in all of it. Three things these seven never made you build: Map Buttons, which put a place on the world map rather than on another room's strip; Music; and SFX. All three work like everything you have already done, and the Documentation section on this tab covers them field by field — start with Start here if any of it stopped making sense.
tutorial.rules.shape.body = 角色、地点、对话、美术、记忆和规则——再加上一扇从卧室出发、让你能走进这一切当中的门。有三样东西是这七篇教程从没让你做过的：地图按钮，它把地点放上世界地图而不是另一个房间的导航条；音乐；以及音效。这三样的用法都和你已经做过的一样，本页签的「文档」一节会逐个字段讲解——如果哪里读着读着不明白了，就从「从这里开始」看起。

# Tutorials: the heading of a step
# en: Steps inside steps
tutorial.aQuest.stepsInsideSteps.title = 步骤里的步骤

# Tutorials: what the step says
# en: A task can have subtasks. The journal draws them under it with a small arrow, and never with a tick - even the game's finished subtasks look the same as unfinished ones. Only a top-level task gets the check mark.\n\nOnce a task has subtasks it finishes through them - in order, in any order, or when any one is done, as its Completes box says - so its own conditions and actions go away and its subtasks get them instead. Set it to 'by action' and its subtasks never start at all: they become notes under it, which is how the game gives hints.\n\nA task can also count - three flowers found, five photos taken. Quest actions can set the count, or it can follow a number variable you already keep. Either way it finishes the task when it reaches the target, and only shows beside a top-level task.
tutorial.aQuest.stepsInsideSteps.body = 一个步骤可以有子步骤。日志会带着一个小箭头把它们画在它下面，而且从不打勾——连游戏自己已完成的子步骤，看起来也和没完成的一样。只有顶层步骤才会得到那个对勾。\n\n一旦某个步骤有了子步骤，它就通过子步骤来完成——按顺序、任意顺序，或任选其一完成，具体看它的「完成方式」框——于是它自己的条件和动作就消失了，改由它的子步骤来承担。把它设成「由动作决定」，它的子步骤就永远不会开始：它们变成它下面的注解，游戏正是用这种方式给提示的。\n\n步骤还可以计数——找到三朵花、拍下五张照片。任务动作可以设定这个计数，它也可以跟随你本来就在维护的某个数字变量。无论哪种，计数达到目标就完成这一步，而且只在顶层步骤旁边显示。

# en: From a conversation, too
tutorial.aQuest.conversationToo.title = 从对话里也行

# Tutorials: what the step says
# en: A dialogue node, a rule or a UI button can move a quest as well, with the Quest action: start it, complete the step the player is on, add to a count. The QuestState and QuestCounter conditions ask where a player has got to, so a conversation can wait until a quest is in progress. Both can name the game's own quests too.\n\nThe game only finishes a step that is in progress, so completing the second task before the first is done does nothing at all.
tutorial.aQuest.conversationToo.body = 对话节点、规则或界面按钮同样可以推动任务，靠的是任务动作：开始它、完成玩家当前所在的那一步、给计数加数。QuestState 和 QuestCounter 条件则询问玩家进行到了哪里，于是一段对话可以一直等到某个任务进行中才播放。这两者也都可以点名游戏自有的任务。\n\n游戏只会结束进行中的步骤，所以在第一步还没完成时去完成第二步，什么都不会发生。

# Tutorials: the heading of a step

tutorial.aQuest.beforeRelease.title = 发布之前

# Tutorials: what the step says

tutorial.aQuest.beforeRelease.body = 游戏按任务的运行时名称保存玩家在这个任务上的进度，按步骤的运行时名称保存步骤的进度。等玩家已经装上你的模组包之后再改其中任何一个名字，那个任务就会对所有人从头再来，因为在游戏看来那是另一个任务。\n\n写作期间尽管改名。发布之后，请让这些名字保持不动，改标题和文本就好——那些只是日志显示的内容。

validation.text.notOwnLanguage = 不是用{own}所用的文字书写的，但模组包声明它是用{own}编写的——所以没有自己语言译本的玩家都会读到这样的文字。如果你本想翻译它，请在窗口顶部的列表中切换到那个语言，再在那里输入。如果整个模组包是另一种语言，请在 ModForge 选项卡中更改“编写语言”。

[Pack translations: translating by machine]

# Said against one line that came back damaged. The line is not written and the
# pack's own words are kept, so these explain why a line was left alone.
# en: The translation came back without {codes}.
packText.mt.lostCodes = 翻译回来时少了 {codes}。

# The braces, tags and tokens are named without writing any of them out, since
# writing one here would make it a gap in this text rather than words about one.
# en: The translation does not carry the same words in braces, tags and tokens as the original.
packText.mt.differentCodes = 译文没有保留原文里同样的花括号词语、标签和记号。

# en: The translation came back empty.
packText.mt.empty = 翻译回来是空的。

# Said when a whole run stops. Each explains what to do next, because stopping
# is not a failure: everything already translated is kept.
# en: The translation service sent back a different number of lines from the number it was given, so nothing in that batch could be matched up to the text it came from.
packText.mt.miscounted = 翻译服务返回的行数和发出去的不一样，所以那一批里没有一条能对上它原本的文本。

# en: The translation service refused the request ({status}): {why}
packText.mt.refused = 翻译服务拒绝了这次请求（{status}）：{why}

# en: The translation service would not answer. Everything translated so far is kept - run it again later and it carries on from where it stopped.
packText.mt.noAnswer = 翻译服务没有应答。已经翻好的都保留着——过一会儿再跑一次，它会从停下的地方接着来。

# en: The translation service did not answer in time.
packText.mt.timedOut = 翻译服务没有及时应答。

# en: The translation service answered with something ModForge cannot read. It may have changed, or it may be asking for a captcha in a browser.
packText.mt.unreadable = 翻译服务返回了 ModForge 读不懂的内容。它可能改过了，也可能是在浏览器里要求验证码。

# en: Too many requests in too short a time. Leave it a while and run it again - everything already translated is kept.
packText.mt.tooMany = 短时间内请求太多。先放一会儿再跑一次——已经翻好的都保留着。

# en: The translation service refused this connection. It may have blocked this address for a while, or it may be asking for a captcha in a browser.
packText.mt.blocked = 翻译服务拒绝了这个连接。它可能把这个地址暂时封了，也可能是在浏览器里要求验证码。

# en: The translation service answered {status}.
packText.mt.answered = 翻译服务返回了 {status}。

# Said when too many lines in a row fail the markup check: the engine is answering but not translating.
# en: The translation service is answering, but {damaged} of the last {total} lines came back damaged - so it has probably changed, rather than having trouble with a few lines. The run stopped here; everything translated before this is kept.
packText.mt.notWorking = 翻译服务有应答，但最近 {total} 行里有 {damaged} 行回来是损坏的——所以它很可能改了，而不只是个别几行出问题。翻译在这里停下了；之前翻好的都保留着。

# Said when the test sentence sent before a run does not come back properly translated.
# en: The translation service did not translate a test sentence properly, so nothing of the pack was sent. It may have changed how it answers. Try again later, or use another translation engine.
packText.mt.probeFailed = 翻译服务没能正确翻译一句测试语句，所以模组包的内容一句都没有发送。它可能改变了应答方式。请稍后再试，或换一个翻译引擎。

# Said when Google answers with its block page rather than a translation. Not a slow-down: asking again only makes it last longer, so the run stops at once.
# en: Google has stopped answering this connection for now - it says your network may be sending automated queries, and wants a captcha solved in a browser. It usually lifts on its own after a while, so try again later. Everything already translated is kept.
packText.mt.captcha = 谷歌暂时不再响应这个连接——它说你的网络可能在发送自动化请求，要求在浏览器里完成验证码。这通常过一段时间会自己解除，请稍后再试。已经翻好的内容都会保留。

# The title of the small window that shows the Google Translate web page while a pack is translated through it
# en: Translating through the Google Translate website

# en: Your pack's text is sent to Google's free translation service. It is not an official one: it can refuse, it can block your connection for a while if asked too often, and it can change without warning. If it stops working, ModForge tries the Google Translate website instead, in a small window you can see. Nothing is sent while anyone is playing - the translation is written into your pack and stays there. Everything a machine writes is marked, and you can correct any of it by writing over it.
translatePack.warning = 你的模组包文本会发送给谷歌的免费翻译服务。那不是官方接口：它可能拒绝，请求太频繁时可能把你的连接封一段时间，也可能毫无预告地改掉。如果它不能用了，ModForge 会改用谷歌翻译网站，在一个你看得到的小窗口里进行。游戏过程中不会发送任何东西——译文写进你的模组包里，就留在那儿。机器写的内容都会标出来，你可以直接覆盖改写任何一行。

translatePack.names.warning = 不勾选时，每个角色的名字都保持原样（在有自己文字的语言中用该文字拼写），无论是名字本身，还是台词中以大写字母提到它的地方。勾选后，名字会像其他文本一样被翻译，而翻译器会把名字当成它看起来像的那个词：一个叫 Hope 的角色，可能在每一句提到她的台词里都变成“希望”。

# Core[Active-Level]
# en: Number of the place the player last travelled to with the map (14 beach, 19 bar, 25 mall...). Scenes that send you straight home do not change it.
vhint.Core.Active-Level = 玩家上次用地图前往的地点编号（14 海滩、19 酒吧、25 商场……）。直接送你回家的场景不会改变它。

# Core[Upcoming-Level]
# en: The place a map or travel button has picked to go to next; the trip copies it into 'Active-Level' and then sets it back to 0.
vhint.Core.Upcoming-Level = 地图按钮或出行按钮选定接下来要去的地点；出行时会把它复制到「Active-Level」，然后把它设回 0。

# Core[Special-Fam-Check]
# en: True if the names the player chose contain mom, mother, dad, father or son; the game then also uses family words (Parents, Family, Sister) in other names.
vhint.Core.Special-Fam-Check = 如果玩家选择的名字包含 mom、mother、dad、father 或 son，则为真；游戏随后也会在其他名字中使用家庭用词（Parents、Family、Sister）。

# Core[Lock-Game]
# en: True while a scene, talk or transition is running; the map, travel keys, room buttons and the Talk button do nothing until it is false again.
vhint.Core.Lock-Game = 场景、对话或过渡进行期间为真；在它重新为假之前，地图、出行按键、房间按钮和 Talk 按钮都不起作用。

# Core[Start-Transfer]
# en: Set true by a map or travel button to start the trip to the place in 'Upcoming-Level'; the travel script sets it back to false when the move is done.
vhint.Core.Start-Transfer = 地图按钮或出行按钮把它设为真，以开始前往「Upcoming-Level」中的地点；移动完成后出行脚本把它设回假。

# Core[Cash]
# en: Money the player has (200 at the start, capped at 50,000,000). Shops and payments take from it; the nightly Starmaker payout, jobs and winnings add to it.
vhint.Core.Cash = 玩家拥有的钱（开始时 200，上限 50,000,000）。商店和付款从中扣除；每晚的 Starmaker 结算、工作和奖金会增加它。

# Core[Daily-Income]
# en: Starmaker income, never paid out or lowered: photos (+25), shoots and some scenes raise it. At 5000+ Frank, the insurance man, can visit the garage on Mondays.
vhint.Core.Daily-Income = Starmaker 收入，从不发放也不降低：照片（+25）、拍摄和一些场景会提高它。达到 5000+ 时，保险员 Frank 可能在周一来车库拜访。

# Core[Follower]
# en: Followers on the Starmaker page; photos, shoots and events add them. Sleeping on a Tuesday cuts them to 60% unless Celeste's quest is done.
vhint.Core.Follower = Starmaker 页面上的关注者；照片、拍摄和事件会增加关注者。周二睡觉会把它削减到 60%，除非 Celeste 的任务已完成。

# Core[Subscriber]
# en: Subscribers on the Starmaker page; each night's payout pays per subscriber. Sleeping on a Friday usually cuts them to 40% (50% with the Loyal Makers perk).
vhint.Core.Subscriber = Starmaker 页面上的订阅者；每晚的结算按订阅者支付。周五睡觉通常会把它削减到 40%（有 Loyal Makers 天赋时为 50%）。

# Core[Debt]

# Core[Auto-Skip]

# en: How big the bust is drawn. 1× puts one of the preview's pixels on one of the screen's, which is the sharpest it gets; 2× doubles every pixel and is just as exact. The half steps in between have to be resampled, so they look a little softer. The panel grows with it, and the choice is remembered.
characters.previewSize.tip = 半身像绘制得多大。1× 让预览的一个像素正好对应屏幕上的一个像素，这是最清晰的；2× 把每个像素翻倍，同样精确。中间的半档需要重新采样，所以看起来会稍软一些。面板会随之一起变大，你的选择也会被记住。
